leadershipTeam.quote: Our greatest strength lies in our commitment to quality, innovation, human capital empowerment, and enduring customer trust.
paragraphs: At ZM Printing & Design Ltd., we specialize in Screen Printing, Sublimation Printing, Silicon Badges, and PVC Badges, delivering creative and reliable solutions designed to meet the diverse needs of the global garment and fashion industry.
Our strategic governance ensures zero-defect quality standards, employee safety, maternal care facilities, and eco-certified green production across our 30,000 SQFT facility in Ashulia.
We believe sustainable manufacturing begins with valuing every artisan and engineer in our workforce while nurturing long-term partnerships with international fashion labels.
